reason: Commander continuity/domain-coverage correction before runner implementation or any broad-range result. The original three-shape line axis omitted already-merged PR #8 seven-rider long-line support including 4-3, 4-2-1 and 4-1-1-1. Owner explicitly identified 3-4/4-3 before result. Original preregistration remains immutable history.

pre_result_disclosure.existing_project_evidence_recovered: Merged PR #8 explicitly supports seven-rider 4-3, 4-2-1 and 4-1-1-1 topology fixtures and separates topology support from effect assumptions and real frequency.

design_correction.method: Use merged long_line_topology_fixture_v1.apply_line_shape_fixture on an already-generated race so rider ability, visible PRE descriptors, class/style/tactical values, bank and wind remain unchanged while only line membership/position/size changes.
design_correction.counterfactual_goal: Compare the same rider PRE world under alternative line topology rather than regenerate a different rider field for each topology.

seven_rider_partition_audit.coverage_rule: All integer partitions of seven are mechanically covered as topology stress. Partition order is canonicalized largest-to-smallest; 3-4 and 4-3 are the same topology shape L43. No partition is assigned a real population frequency.
seven_rider_partition_audit.tier_B_interpretation: Mechanical falsification extremes only. Do not call these common, plausible-frequency, or representative real-keirin structures without independent PRE evidence.

reporting_lock.reason: Extreme mechanically valid topology partitions must not numerically dominate the primary robustness summary as if they had real population weight.
